name: Askavan, Succubus

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Infernal Luck
traits.details: Enemies in the aura take a -4 penalty to saving throws.

auras.name: Infernal Luck
auras.details: Enemies in the aura take a -4 penalty to saving throws.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 5 fire and necrotic damage (save ends).

effect.description: Askavan slides the target up to 2 squares.

powers.name: Charming Touch
powers.usageDetails: when no creature is affected by this power

hit.description: The target cannot attack Askavan. The effect lasts until Askavan or one of her allies attacks the target or Askavan drops to 0 hit points. If the target is affected by charming touch at the end of the encounter, the effect lasts until Askavan fails to touch the target during a 24-hour period.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one nondeafened creature in the burst

hit.description: The target chooses either to be dominated by Askavan until the end of Askavan’s next turn or to take 2d10 + 10 psychic damage and fall prone.

effect.description: Askavan teleports up to 5 squares and makes a melee attack.

Askavan alters her physical form to appear as a Medium humanoid until she uses change shape again or until she drops to 0 hit points. To assume a specific individual’s form, Askavan must have seen that individual. Other creatures can attempt a DC 30 Insight check to discern that the form is a disguise.

powers.name: Loyal Consort
powers.trigger: A melee or ranged attack targets Askavan while she is adjacent to a creature dominated by her or affected by her charming touch.

effect.description: The triggering attack instead targets the creature dominated by Askavan or affected by her charming touch.
